DataRecovery for Mac - SD card / pen drive bata delete bhayeka files recover garne app
===================================================================================

Install garne
-------------
1. DataRecovery.dmg double-click garnus.
2. Khuleko window ma DataRecovery lai "Applications" folder ma tannus (drag).
3. Pahilo choti kholda: Applications ma DataRecovery ma RIGHT-CLICK > "Open"
   > "Open" thichnus. (App Apple bata sign/notarize gareko chhaina.)
   "Open" dekhiena bhane: System Settings > Privacy & Security ma tala
   "DataRecovery was blocked" ko chheuma "Open Anyway" thichnus.
   Apple Silicon (M1/M2/M3/M4) ra Intel dubai Mac ma chalchha (macOS 11+).

Kasari chalaune
---------------
1. Card Mac ma halnus. Card ma naya kehi copy NAGARNUS.
2. DataRecovery kholnus. Mathi dayan tira "English / नेपाली" le bhasha
   pherna milchha.
3. Card chhannus, Quick scan wa Deep scan chhannus, "Start scan" thichnus.
   - Mac le "authopen wants to make changes" bhanera password sodhchha -
     card sidhai padhna yo chahinchha. Card ma kahile pani kei lekhdaina.
   - Scan suru hunu aghi app le card unmount garchha (Finder bata harauchha)
     - yasle macOS lai card ma lekhna rokchha. Kaam sakiye pachhi card
     nikalera feri halnus.
4. Files chhannus. Photo ma click garda thulo preview dekhinchha.
5. Save garne folder chhannus ("Browse..."; Desktop pahile nai bhariyeko
   hunchha), "Recover" thichnus.
6. Sakiye pachhi "Open folder" le Finder ma files dekhauchha.

"The drive could not be opened" dekhayo bhane
---------------------------------------------
Password halnu bhayo tara pani aayo bhane: System Settings > Privacy &
Security > Full Disk Access ma "+" thichera Applications bata DataRecovery
thapnus (on garnus), ani DataRecovery Quit (Cmd+Q) garera feri kholnus.

Uninstall
---------
Applications bata DataRecovery lai Trash ma halnus.

Thaha hunuparne kura
--------------------
- SD card, pen drive, external hard disk ra Mac ko afnai drive sabai list ma
  aaphai dekhinchhan. Naya drive jodda aaphai dekhinchha.
- Quick scan (naam ra folder sahit): FAT32, exFAT ra NTFS drive ma chalchha.
  APFS/HFS+ drive ma Deep scan matra chalchha.
- Mac ko afnai drive encrypted hunchha ra SSD le TRIM gardachha, tesaile
  tyasbata dherai kam files aaunchhan. Card, pen drive, hard disk ma thik.
- Deep scan le naam haraisakeka photos/videos pani khojchha, tara dherai
  samaya lagchha (128 GB card ma 30 minute dekhi 1 ghanta).
- Card ma naya files lekhiyeko thau ma purana files overwrite hunchhan.
  Jati chhito recover garyo, utti dherai files aaunchhan.
